heading.en: Two metres of DNA in every cell

hook.en: If you stretched out the DNA from one of your cells it would be about two metres long, yet it fits into a nucleus a few micrometres across.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಂದು ಕೋಶದ DNAಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸುಮಾರು ಎರಡು ಮೀಟರ್ ಉದ್ದ, ಆದರೂ ಅದು ಕೆಲವು ಮೈಕ್ರೋಮೀಟರ್ ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A nucleotide has a nitrogenous base, a pentose sugar and a phosphate group. Bases join sugars by N-glycosidic bonds; nucleotides join by 3'-5' phosphodiester bonds. Chargaff found that in double-stranded DNA A = T and G = C. Using X-ray diffraction data from Wilkins and Franklin, Watson and Crick proposed the double helix in 1953: two antiparallel strands, A paired with T by two hydrogen bonds and G with C by three. The pitch is 3.4 nm with about 10 bp per turn, so adjacent base pairs are 0.34 nm apart.
body.kn: ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರಜನಕ ಕ್ಷಾರ, ಪೆಂಟೋಸ್ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಫಾಸ್ಫೇಟ್ ಇವೆ. ವಾಟ್ಸನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಿಕ್ 1953ರಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಸುರುಳಿ ಮಾದರಿ ಮಂಡಿಸಿದರು. A–T ಎರಡು, G–C ಮೂರು ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಬಂಧಗಳು. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆ 10 ಕ್ಷಾರ ಜೊತೆಗಳು, 3.4 nm.

title.en: Board: the double helix and its packaging

say.en: Draw DNA as a ladder: two sugar-phosphate backbones running in opposite directions, five prime to three prime and three prime to five prime.
The rungs are base pairs: A always pairs with T by two hydrogen bonds, G with C by three.
One turn of the helix is 3.4 nanometres and holds about ten base pairs, so the pairs are 0.34 nanometres apart. Chargaff: purines equal pyrimidines.
In eukaryotes DNA wraps around a histone octamer to form a nucleosome of about 200 base pairs. Nucleosomes make the beads-on-string fibre, which coils into chromosomes.
Histones are rich in lysine and arginine, so they are positive and hold the negative DNA. Loose euchromatin is active; dense heterochromatin is inactive.

body.en: In prokaryotes the negatively charged DNA is held with positively charged proteins in the nucleoid. In eukaryotes, DNA wraps around a histone octamer, rich in the basic amino acids lysine and arginine, to form a nucleosome of about 200 bp. Repeating nucleosomes form a 'beads-on-string' chromatin fibre, which coils further into chromosomes with the help of non-histone chromosomal (NHC) proteins. Loosely packed, lightly staining euchromatin is transcriptionally active; densely packed, darkly staining heterochromatin is inactive.
body.kn: ಯೂಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ DNA ಹಿಸ್ಟೋನ್ ಅಷ್ಟಕದ ಸುತ್ತ ಸುತ್ತಿ ಸುಮಾರು 200 ಕ್ಷಾರ ಜೊತೆಗಳ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಸೋಮ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಯೂಕ್ರೊಮ್ಯಾಟಿನ್ ಸಕ್ರಿಯ, ಹೆಟೆರೊಕ್ರೊಮ್ಯಾಟಿನ್ ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯ.
